name: models
description_en: Models and examples built with TensorFlow
readme_excerpt: Welcome to the Model Garden for TensorFlow The TensorFlow Model Garden is a repository with a number of different implementations of state-of-the-art (SOTA) models and modeling solutions for TensorFlow users. We aim to demonstrate the best practices for modeling so that TensorFlow users can take full advantage of TensorFlow for their research and product development.
